PRD 4.2 activation is complete when a single-use expiring token delivered out-of-process verifies in the app and expired or reused links recover cleanly.
Section 10 acceptance holds when the golden path works under the disposable isolation profile that approximates an external user environment.
mandatory_objectives: Cover gap:prd_golden_path exactly once through the single task and keep its acceptance measurable by host instruments.
Own each pinned evidence-stalled issue with the task's rewrite_acceptance disposition and route host-side repairs to Host follow-up.

Keep validate:tauri_source_manifest and validate:prd_implementation_review passing while making the golden path externally drivable.
task_specification.objective: Make the PRD golden path provable by instruments other than the candidate's own counters: verify and harden the out-of-process focusboard:// activation preconditions under disposable-xdg isolation, keep every first-run step drivable through visible UI and OS entry points, and rewrite the three stalled acceptances so host receipts measure external actions — with the host collector and probe repairs routed to Host follow-up.

diagnosis.root_cause: Loops 8-10 repeated one strategy: candidate-side collectors and self-drives were asked to prove the PRD golden path. Loop 10 delivered the full machinery (desktop-entry scheme registration, warm socket listener, cold argv parsing, deeplink counters, and a 16/16 self-drive twice), yet both receipts still record external_deeplink=not_run because the host lane launches the app directly and never reads the counters, and the isolation advisory probes com.focusboard.app instead of the real app.focusboard.desktop. The three active findings are therefore one measurement stall in the host evidence chain, not missing product behavior; patching the candidate collector-side again is precisely the exhausted strategy.

stop_conditions: If the replay environment cannot resolve or execute an out-of-process focusboard:// activation at all, stop activation work, record the lane limitation as Host follow-up, and bind acceptance to the strongest measurable form: desktop-entry registration plus the paste-lane journey.
If making scheme registration effective requires new crate dependencies unavailable in the offline vendor set, stop and report blocked instead of hand-rolling an unreviewed protocol.
If any journey change risks regressing the sign_out remount fix or the terminal probe state across sign-out, revert the change and keep the loop-10 surface.

strategy.rationale: Three loops asked candidate-side collectors to prove the golden path and the receipts still record not_run and unread counters. This plan inverts the evidence authority: the candidate's already-built activation machinery (desktop-entry scheme registration, warm socket listener, cold argv parsing) becomes the recapture enabler, acceptance is rewritten to host-executed external actions measurable with the current webdriver and receipt instruments, and the remaining host collector and probe repairs are routed to Host follow-up instead of being re-patched candidate-side a fourth time.

runtime: Self-validation launches the app under the disposable XDG tree, resolves the scheme handler via xdg-mime, and completes one cold and one warm focusboard:// activation landing on the expected view.

The replay lane performs the first-run journey as external actions — typed registration, link consumption, refresh, sign-out, restart sign-in — under embedded-assets build mode with disposable-xdg isolation retained.

One cold and one warm focusboard:// activation complete the PRD 4.2 token flow in focused self-validation with the UI landing on the expected view, counters treated as diagnostics only.

Every section-3 journey step is executable through visible UI or OS entry points with no dependence on the golden-path self-drive trigger, and the sign_out remount fix plus terminal probe state are preserved.

Normal product startup performs no test-account creation, login, mail-token consumption, or synthetic data mutation; the anonymous invalid-email lane remains opt-in and isolated.

evidence_resolution.rationale: find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered: acceptance is rewritten from unread candidate counters to a host-executed out-of-process activation (xdg-open warm and cold) bound in observed.external_deeplink; the candidate makes the registration and routing preconditions verifiable, and the missing receipt-owned xdg-open stage is assigned to Host follow-up per the ledger retest recipe. find.first-run-gui-drive-missing: acceptance is rewritten to what current instruments measure — the focusboard-native-webdriver lane performing typed-form registration, mail-sink link consumption through the visible verify lane, refresh, sign-out, and restart sign-in as external actions, with no candidate counter cited. find.isolated-store-probe-path-mismatch: the advisory is conclusive only when measured against app.focusboard.desktop; the probe repair in tools/tauri_native_lifecycle.py is a Host collector repair routed to Host follow-up, and until then the result must be labeled not-applicable/pending rather than false.

tasks.instructions: Own the three pinned evidence-stalled findings as one root-cause cluster and break the exhausted collector strategy. Preserve all loop-10 validated assets: the two-run signed-in surface capture protocol, disposable-xdg isolation with embedded-assets build, the sign_out root-element remount fix in src/App.tsx, the anonymous invalid-email validation lane, and the golden-path probe kept in its registered lane with honest authority labeling. Candidate work is bounded to making the golden path externally drivable and the activation preconditions real: confirm the focusboard:// desktop-entry registration and xdg-mime default resolve inside the replay's disposable XDG tree with FOCUSBOARD_DATA_DIR carried through, keep cold argv parsing and the warm socket listener correct for out-of-process activations, and keep every section-3 step (typed registration, link consumption via the visible verify lane, refresh persistence, sign-out, restart sign-in) reachable through semantic DOM and OS entry points only. Do not cite candidate counters or self-drive outcomes as journey acceptance; do not edit host tooling — the tools/tauri_native_lifecycle.py probe path and the receipt-owned xdg-open activation stage are Host follow-up recorded in the ledger.
